caption: A write at version 5 reaches R1 and R2, while R3 still holds version 4 with x = 7. A read that touches R3 but not R2 can return the old value, which is why R + W > N matters.

spec.title: Quorum write with a stale replica
spec.aria: A client writes x = 10 to replicas R1 and R2, which both hold version 5, while R3 still holds version 4 with x = 7 and answers a stale read.
